_comment: Title styles available to title_add. Edit freely: id (lower_snake_case), font, weight (400 normal, 700 bold), size (px at 1080p, scaled to the project height), color / outlineColor / box as r,g,b,a, outline (px), position (top | center | lower_third | bottom), fadeIn / fadeOut (seconds), box = translucent band behind the text (omit for none).

presets.description: white bold text on a dark translucent band in the lower third, 0.3s fades
large bold centered headline on a dark translucent band, 0.5s fades
medium caption on a dark band at the top, no fades
subtitle-style text near the bottom edge, 0.15s fades
